name: hospital-platform
description: Enterprise Domain-Driven Microservices Hospital Management Platform & ProHealth Website

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run --workspace=packages/contracts build && npm run --workspace=packages/events build && npm run --workspace=packages/audit-client build && npm run --workspace=packages/database build
scripts.build:services: npm run --workspace=apps/appointment-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/patient-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/clinical-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/auth-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/audit-service build && npm run --workspace=apps/api-gateway build
scripts.build:apps: npm run --workspace=apps/website build && npm run --workspace=apps/erp build

author: Hospital Engineering Team
